summary: Iteration 10 backend-only regression after the secrets-module swap in _generate_username(). Ran the FULL existing suite (backend_test.py + test_iteration4/5/6/7/7_rca/8/9): 135/135 passed. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10.py covering (a) 3 signups with identical display_name 'Common Name' -> all succeed with unique usernames matching ^[a-z0-9_]{3,20}$ and a numeric 100-9999 suffix, (b) /auth/me returns non-empty valid username for a minimal display_name seed, (c) POST /api/ai/suggest-category {title:'Bicycle helmet'} returns 200 with a non-empty category string. 3/3 new tests passed. Code review of _generate_username confirms secrets.randbelow(9900)+100 (range 100-9999, correct API) and secrets.token_hex(3) fallback are valid; collision loop retries 10x before fallback. Frontend not tested per request.
critical_code_review_comments: _generate_username imports re/secrets inside the function on every call; move to module-level imports for clarity (cosmetic only, no functional impact).
Fallback f"trader{secrets.token_hex(3)}" is not uniqueness-checked against the DB; probability is tiny but a final find_one guard would make it deterministic.
